newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CST starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CST starts as buy.

text.p: -- Nomura Research Institute America said it had started coverage of Brazilian steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica de Tubarao with a rating of buy.
-- Analyst Steven Assis wrote in a Jan 21 report, "We believe CST is at the beginning of a strong product cycle, and its positive momentum should last through 1997-98.
-- "We project ... (earnings per 1,000 shares) of $2.24 in 1996, $2.65 in 1997 and $3.90 in 1998.
-- "Our target price for CST's (preferred) stock is $22 per 1,000 shares, a 45 percent increase over the next 12 months."
-- Assis gave the preferred share's closing price on Tuesday as $15.
